Leadership
A look at the people and mission behind Nexor Sparks — this section will grow as the team does.
Founder & CEO
Gursharan Singh
Founded Nexor and leads product, engineering and company direction.
Co-Founder
Anmol Sunda
Co-founded Nexor and helps shape the product alongside the founder.
Executive Team
Nexor Sparks is a small, focused team today. As we grow, additional leaders and department heads will be listed here.
Mission
To give people a fast, honest space to share what's happening right now — and to build the tools that make that sharing feel alive, not performative.
Vision
A world where real-time conversation is open, safe, and owned by the people having it — not buried under noise.

Privacy Policy
How Nexor Sparks collects, uses, and protects your information.
Information we collect — account details you provide (name, username, email), content you post, and basic device/usage data needed to run the app.

How we use it — to operate your feed, personalize what you see, keep the app secure, and communicate important account updates.

Sharing — we don't sell your personal data. Limited data is shared with service providers (e.g. hosting, notifications) strictly to run the app.

Your controls — you can edit or delete your content, download your data, and delete your account at any time from Settings.

Security — we use industry-standard safeguards, but no system is 100% secure — please use a strong, unique password.

For the complete, legally-binding policy, see the full version on our Help Center.
Last updated: —
Terms of Use
The rules and conditions for using Nexor Sparks.
Your account — you're responsible for what's posted from your account and for keeping your login secure.

Acceptable use — no harassment, hate speech, spam, impersonation, or illegal content. Accounts that break these rules may be restricted or removed.

Your content — you keep ownership of what you post; you grant Nexor Sparks a license to display and distribute it within the app.

Availability — the service is provided "as is." Features may change, and we may suspend accounts that violate these terms.

Termination — you can delete your account any time; we may suspend accounts for violations of these terms or the Community Guidelines.

For the complete, legally-binding terms, see the full version on our Help Center.
